criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt explicitly bans AI visual tells (pure black, neon glow, generic card layouts, Inter/Roboto fonts)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The skill prompt explicitly bans pure black, neon glows, 3-column generic card layouts, and the Inter font in the 'AI TELLS (Forbidden Patterns)' section.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires all 7 interaction states (default, hover, active, focus, loading, empty, error)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt explicitly requires focus-visible, loading, empty, error, and active (tactile feedback) states, while also mentioning hover states, covering the full interaction cycle.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt specifies spring/ease curves, not linear. Avoids janky animations.
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt explicitly mandates premium Spring Physics (stiffness: 100, damping: 20) and cubic-bezier curves, explicitly banning linear easing.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces clear typography hierarchy with specific font choices
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt enforces deterministic typography with specific classes for Display/Headlines and Body/Paragraphs, and mandates specific font choices like Geist, Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, or Satoshi.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt uses a deliberate color system, not arbitrary hex values
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt includes a 'Color Calibration' rule that restricts designs to max 1 accent color, mandates absolute neutral bases (Zinc/Slate), and enforces strict color consistency.

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt enforces consistent spacing scale (not random padding/margin values)
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt requires mathematically perfect padding and margins, standardizes breakpoints, and enforces specific gap utilities (e.g., gap-2 for inputs).

criteriaResults.description: Skill prompt requires WCAG contrast ratios and focus-visible indicators
criteriaResults.reasoning: The prompt has a mandatory Accessibility section that explicitly requires WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios and clear focus-visible indicators for all interactive elements.
